thought.text: I found the issue — the form uses `user[login]` instead of `user[email]`. Let me retry the login with the correct field name.

reasoning_content: The form field is `user[login]`, not `user[email]`! My earlier login attempt used `user[email]`, which would be nil for the `login` key — Devise would try to authenticate with a blank login → failure. That's my mistake, not a bug in the installation. Let me redo the login with `user[login]`.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj3.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj3.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in | grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && curl -s -b cj3.txt -c cj3.txt -o /dev/null -w "POST login: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[login]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" && curl -s -b cj3.txt -o /dev/null -w "GET /admin: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3000/admin && curl -s -b cj3.txt http://localhost:3000/admin | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1 && curl -s -b cj3.txt http://localhost:3000/admin/dashboard 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1

tool_call.name: terminal
